items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: I saw him. I saw him. I saw him.

ctx.x: I think it is Queen Victoria.

I'm a little off on that, I think. That sounds like the right, but I can't remember which it's with. Yeah, well I got mixed up myself on that. I think she's right. I think it is Queen Victoria. I've heard people talk about him and there's a book that has something about Billy Kershaw. Yeah, lots about Billy Kershaw. Well, I saw him. I saw him. I saw him. And Billika Sam is the first person that ever made her laugh during her whole lifetime for childhood. And when he opened his mouth, she didn't laugh. And she,…
I interviewed anybody who spoke of Billika Sam. Oh, yeah.
